cards.title: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for AI Infrastructure
cards.body: Stripe has acquired OpenRouter, a startup that routes prompts between different AI models. The payments giant claims the move addresses "the singularity," but the real motivation lies in infrastructure capabilities for enterprise AI.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Enterprise Privacy Protections
cards.body: OpenAI is competing with Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data. The initiative reflects growing demand for secure AI solutions in corporate settings.

cards.title: Cognition Denies SpaceX Acquisition Reports
cards.body: SpaceX reportedly attempted to acquire AI coding startup Cognition as it races to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor, signaling aggressive expansion in enterprise AI.

cards.title: Consumer Adoption of AI Faces Skepticism
cards.body: Despite increased availability, consumers remain wary of AI technology. Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn't necessarily translate to user acceptance.

cards.title: Google Integrates Gemini into Search Features
cards.body: Google has launched new AI study tools combining Search and Gemini for students. The move positions Gemini as a competitive alternative to OpenAI's educational offerings.

cards.title: OpenAI Revokes Researcher Cyber Program Access
cards.body: OpenAI revoked access to its Trusted Access for Cyber program, which provided trusted security researchers with advanced models. The program aimed to accelerate vulnerability reporting and patching.

cards.title: Startup Valuates AI Compute Pricing
cards.body: A new startup is helping Wall Street price AI compute costs, a critical metric as data center spending reaches hundreds of billions annually. Compute has become the primary cost driver for AI product development.

cards.title: TerraPower Powers AI Data Centers Strategically
cards.body: TerraPower's nuclear reactor offers a competitive advantage for powering AI data centers with clean, reliable energy. The technology positions the company favorably in securing major infrastructure deals.

cards.title: Amazon Makes Alexa+ Free on Fire TV
cards.body: Amazon is automatically upgrading all Fire TV users to its AI-powered Alexa+ assistant without requiring Prime membership. The move democratizes access to advanced AI assistant features.

cards.title: Calendly Launches AI Meeting Assistant Callie
cards.body: Calendly has released Callie, an AI-powered meeting scheduling assistant. The product extends Calendly's suite of AI-enhanced productivity tools.

cards.title: Data Quality Critical for Cancer AI Solutions
cards.body: A startup argues that AI won't cure cancer without access to high-quality training data. The company emphasizes data infrastructure as the key bottleneck in medical AI advancement.

cards.title: Relativity Networks Accelerates Data Center Fiber
cards.body: Relativity Networks raised $22 million for hollow-core fiber technology enabling 30% faster data transmission. The innovation addresses critical speed needs for AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Cursor Launches GitHub Rival Code Hosting
cards.body: Cursor, the AI Code Editor startup, launched a new code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move capitalizes on developer frustration with incumbent platforms.

cards.title: OpenAI Strengthens Safeguards Post-Breach
cards.body: Following the Hugging Face breach, OpenAI implemented new safeguards including enhanced development monitoring and stronger post-training alignment practices. The measures focus on security and model reliability.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21 Billion
cards.body: Etched's valuation doubled to $21 billion in one month after Jane Street successfully installed its AI cluster system. The impressive results led Jane Street to lead another major funding round.

cards.title: Apple's Camera AirPods Address Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods may mitigate privacy concerns by preventing users from recording photos and videos. The design prevents common privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables.

cards.title: Warp Launches AI Software Factory System
cards.body: Warp introduced Warp Factories, an infrastructure system simplifying AI software development workflows. The platform aims to make building AI systems as accessible as possible.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases ChatGPT for Teens
cards.body: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Teens with age-appropriate safety measures and parental controls. The offering includes learning tools designed to prevent academic dishonesty and harmful content exposure.

cards.title: Perplexity Gains Millions of Users in India
cards.body: Perplexity's India revenue surged 60% following its free offer partnership with Airtel, even as new downloads declined. The initiative demonstrated strong market demand in emerging markets.

cards.title: Anthropic's Revenue Reaches $65 Billion Annualized
cards.body: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching a total of $65 billion. The rapid growth reflects surging enterprise demand for its AI models.

cards.title: Stripe acquires OpenRouter for AI model routing
cards.body: Stripe has acquired OpenRouter, a startup that routes prompts between different AI models. The payments giant claims it's about preparing for the "singularity," but the real motivation is more immediate and practical.

cards.title: OpenAI and Anthropic battle over data privacy
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic are competing to offer the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data. The competition reflects growing concerns about data security in AI applications.

cards.title: SpaceX pursues AI coding startup Cognition
cards.body: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to acquire AI coding startup Cognition as it races to build enterprise AI capabilities. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor, signaling aggressive competition with OpenAI and Anthropic.

cards.title: AI adoption faces consumer skepticism hurdle
cards.body: Despite becoming harder to avoid, consumers are growing increasingly wary of AI technology. Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn't automatically lead to acceptance.

cards.title: Google launches Gemini study tools for students
cards.body: Google is integrating new AI study features into Search and Gemini to attract student users. The launch represents Google's latest effort to compete with OpenAI in the education market.

cards.title: OpenAI revokes researcher access to cyber program
cards.body: OpenAI revoked researchers' access to its Trusted Access for Cyber program, which provided improved models for identifying security vulnerabilities. The program aimed to accelerate bug reporting and patching.

cards.title: Startup brings pricing transparency to AI compute
cards.body: A new startup is helping Wall Street price AI compute costs as spending on data centers and GPUs reaches hundreds of billions annually. Compute has become the single biggest expense for AI companies.

cards.title: TerraPower's nuclear reactor powers AI data centers
cards.body: TerraPower's nuclear power plant offers strategic advantages for powering AI data centers compared to competitors. The technology positions the company as a key player in AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Amazon makes Alexa+ free on Fire TV devices
cards.body: Amazon is automatically upgrading all Fire TV users to its AI-powered Alexa+ assistant for free, regardless of Prime subscription status. The move expands access to Amazon's advanced AI assistant.

cards.title: Calendly launches AI meeting scheduling assistant
cards.body: Calendly has released Callie, an AI-powered meeting scheduling assistant. The tool represents the company's expansion into AI-driven productivity features.

cards.title: Startup tackles AI's cancer research data problem
cards.body: A new startup argues that quality data, not AI models alone, is essential for using AI to cure cancer. The company is addressing a critical bottleneck in medical AI development.

cards.title: Cursor launches code-hosting rival to GitHub
cards.body: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move capitalizes on developer frustration with existing platforms.

cards.title: OpenAI tightens safeguards after Hugging Face breach
cards.body: OpenAI has instituted new safeguards including enhanced monitoring during model development and greater focus on alignment and security. The measures follow a breach at Hugging Face.

cards.title: Etched's valuation doubles to $21 billion
cards.body: Etched's valuation doubled to $21B in one month after Jane Street deployed the startup's first AI cluster system. The impressive performance prompted Jane Street to lead a massive follow-up round.

cards.title: Apple's camera AirPods include privacy safeguards
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods may avoid privacy concerns by preventing users from recording photos and videos. The design choice addresses potential misuse of AI wearables.

cards.title: Warp launches AI software factory infrastructure
cards.body: Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to simplify building AI software factories. The platform aims to democratize AI development for developers.

cards.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for teenagers
cards.body: OpenAI has released ChatGPT for Teens with age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools. The version aims to steer teenagers away from harmful content and academic cheating.

cards.title: Perplexity gains millions of users in India
cards.body: Perplexity's free AI offer through Airtel in India resulted in millions of additional users, with revenue rising 60% even after the promotion ended. The strategy proved effective for market penetration.

cards.title: Anthropic's annualized revenue surges to $65B
cards.body: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching a total of $65B. The dramatic growth reflects surging demand for the AI model maker's products.

cards.title: AI's self-improvement promises face skepticism
cards.body: The AI industry's bold promise that AI will soon improve itself may not materialize as quickly as expected. Researchers question whether recursive self-improvement will happen without human oversight.

cards.title: Real AI usage data remains largely opaque
cards.body: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI publish usage reports, but only release data they choose to share. Researchers note there's no independent source to verify these claims.

cards.title: AI recursive self-improvement slower than predicted
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest promise—that AI will soon improve itself with minimal human oversight—may take longer than forecasted. LLMs can write code and generate synthetic training data, but recursive improvement has limits.
